depictions.name: Takahara Kumano Shrine
depictions.text: Takahara Kumano Shrine is a Shinto shrine south of Takahara Village in Kii, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke arrived at the shrine and paid respects to two of its smaller shrines.
